name: NIFTY ATM CE/PE Independent 0.9% Breakout
description: Independent ATM CE and ATM PE premium breakout strategy using the 09:15-09:20 option close as each leg's reference. Upper/lower levels are ±0.9%. Each leg can independently enter, partially exit at +20 and +40 points, exit below its lower level, re-enter after becoming flat, and square off at 15:10 IST.

advancedFeatures.signalSource: ATM CE and ATM PE option premium closes
advancedFeatures.contractResolution: Lock 09:20 ATM strike and nearest weekly expiry
advancedFeatures.executionResolution: 1-minute OHLC for target fills; 5-minute close for lower-level exit
